## About
Damage Control Auto Body is a family owned and operated body shop in McCook. Our main specialty is auto body work and painting, and we also offer interior and exterior detailing.
We built this shop around your comfort and peace of mind. When your vehicle is with us, our goal is that it gets repaired correctly, safely and in an efficient amount of time, with checkpoints along the way before any job leaves our facility.
New generation, same great quality. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 83 Google reviews.

## Services
- Paint & collision repair: Auto body work and painting is our main specialty, from front-end damage to nicks, dings and touchups.
- Interior & exterior basic package: Hand wash, bug removal and window cleaning outside, with compressed air dirt removal, vacuuming, panel wipe down and stain removal inside. Offered for a sedan or SUV.
- Interior & exterior deluxe package: A deeper clean with full carpet shampooing, upholstery seat treatment, headliner cleaning, rear storage cleaning and UV protection for interior panels. Offered for a sedan or SUV.
- Additional interior and exterior services: Ceramic coatings, alternative wax protection, paint correction, textured coating, vinyl corrections, carpet and upholstery dye, and seat and carpet removal, available upon request.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Send us a message through our website letting us know what is going on with your vehicle, or give us a call, and we will get back to you with a quote.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. All of our work has a lifetime warranty backed by PPG Paints and Damage Control Inc.
